superseded_runs.reason: Extended with register helper packet/polling replay and local core counter-window mapping; application source unchanged.
EL7 GUI regression retained an obsolete 8-row expectation after expansion to 20 fields; assertion corrected, complete GUI/kernel matrix restarted. Runtime code unchanged.
Native-report JSON test still expected every common field to be unverified; updated to validate all 12 SVI fields and provenance flags. Runtime code unchanged; full CLI matrix restarted.

production_source_comparison.interpretation: Application inputs match the successful Linux/CLI matrix commit. GUI and CLI follow-up commits each correct an outdated frontend test assertion. Runtime inputs are identical across the three successful commits. Research source hashes match the successful REA study. Eight local user extensions are retained.

limits: No real hardware setting or telemetry measurement was verified.
Shimada presence-query mapping is restricted to family 1Ah/model 08h, PCI 1022:153a/BDF 0 and SMU 115.46.0. It maps presence-mask order to firmware target IDs, not OS CPUs/APICs or active cores.

Twelve SVI channel common fields, five core rows and three CCD rows have static reference unit evidence: voltage model, temperature, residency percentages and interval counter ratio. Other units, residency state labels, PM physical mapping and live sensor validity remain unresolved; runtime 61h stays denied.

Granite Ridge native capture is restricted to family 1Ah/model 44h, PCI 1022:14d8/BDF 0, SMU 98.84.0 and exact table 620105/1828 or 620205/2452. Unit interpretation is based on the pinned reference; capture firmware provenance and PM physical mapping remain unverified. The two-slot table optionally maps firmware IDs [0,1] through the pinned initializer; one-slot tables remain ambiguous. CPUID L3 identification is separate from these firmware IDs.

An indexed-code consumer slice feeds a shared floor; independent second-rail physical identity, encoded hardware-request consumption and readback remain unverified. Other firmware/tuning and previously documented remaining features are incomplete.
EL7 means Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64. Windows/macOS validate the portable core, not a complete application port.
QEMU verifies module integration only; actual register settings and Secure Boot were not tested.

register_helper_proof.limits: Scripted ready bits prove marshaling and loops only; a stalled bit exhausts the research budget, not a firmware timeout. Completion is not a verified voltage change or independent setting readback.

limitations: Static discovery is not a proof that every function has been recovered; only byte-checked slices are used.

Twelve SVI common fields, five core and three CCD rows have static unit evidence. SVI values can be stale or zero in scale mode 0; neither channel identity nor applied settings are authenticated. Voltage model is not measured rail voltage; conditional sensors may retain old values; interval ratio is not confirmed CPU utilization. Other units and physical identities remain unresolved.
Firmware two-slot IDs [0,1] do not establish CPUID CCD/APIC or physical core/OS CPU association. One-slot native mapping remains ambiguous.
61h indexed storage and shared-floor selection do not establish independently addressable rails or a second-rail getter.
Reciprocal accuracy, floating exception behavior, peripheral effects and live error semantics were not emulated. Packet encodings and polling are checked only against scripted responses.
Synthetic replay does not establish live timing, freshness, atomicity or target-machine acceptance. ASUS 2503 is a reference, not the installed BIOS.

core_inputs_comparison.interpretation: Runtime code is identical across the successful core, GUI and CLI commits. GUI and CLI follow-ups correct obsolete assertions; each corrected test was run in its own successful matrix. Thirteen research inputs match the separate successful REA commit.
